subject: Short pilot — conditional ramp + usage-based extension request
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@vectrahealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short pilot — request to extend while we ramp new use case

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed by the latency and token-cost numbers on the triage flows. We're about to flip a new dataset into production for a clinical intake funnel and the final regression tests will take ~10 business days.

Two asks: can we (1) get a one-time 3-week extension to the current 30-day pilot so we can finish regression, and (2) temporarily increase the throughput cap for that window to support a staged rollout (we only expect ~50K tokens/day during the ramp). We can't commit to a long-term seat buy yet, but we'd be open to a short-term, usage-based top-up with a modest discount if Redwood can guarantee a capacity buffer for the ramp.

Victor (cc'd) will own the telemetry reporting side and can share the usage spikes as they come. If you need an internal SSO request or anything from IT/security to enable the higher concurrency, let us know.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our pilot ends Apr 10 and we'd ideally have agreement by Apr 7 so Ops can schedule the rollout.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Product
Vectra Health

Attachment: Vectra_Pilot_Usage_Report_Mar2027.pdf (summary, 3 pages)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@vectrahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short pilot — request to extend while we ramp new use case

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and for the usage report. Congrats on getting to the staging roll-out.

Short answer: we can support a 3-week extension with temporary higher throughput, but we need to align on two things before we confirm:
1) A clear cap on expected peak tokens/day during the three weeks (you mentioned ~50K/day — can Victor confirm a safe upper bound?)
2) Discount/packaging: we can offer a usage-topup SKU billed at a pay-as-you-go rate with a 15% discount on the hosted list price for the extension window, OR a timeboxed flat-rate add-on if you prefer predictable billing. Either option would be one-off for the extension and not change your existing conversion pricing.

Kimberly — can you advise whether 15% is something we can authorize at Rishi's level for this one-off, or should we route to pricing ops? Priyom — please pencil capacity and SLA notes for ops (we'll want a limited concurrency SLA for Apr 11–May 1).

Elena — if that sounds reasonable I can send a short SOW addendum and a DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Rishi
VP, Growth
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short pilot — request to extend while we ramp new use case

Rishi — 15% one-off is within my approval for pilot extensions under $10k. If the expected spend based on 50K tokens/day at our hosted rate goes above $10k for the window, I need a note for pricing ops.

Priyom — please prepare: (a) a short SOW addendum template that has both options (usage-topup with 15% off, or flat 3-week add-on at $7,500), (b) an operations playbook entry to bump throughput from the sandbox pool to a reserved burst for Apr 11–May 1, and (c) a sentence about rollback/fallback (auto-throttle to base cap if surge > 2x expected).

If Elena confirms 50K/day nominal, we should be safe.

Kimberly
Head of Pricing & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@vectrahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Victor Huang <victor.h@vectrahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Short pilot — request to extend while we ramp new use case

Elena — looping back with the proposed terms so you can get Ops scheduled:

Proposal (one-off, timeboxed extension)
- Extension window: Apr 11, 2027 00:00 UTC — May 01, 2027 23:59 UTC (3 weeks)
- Throughput buffer: reserve up to 75K tokens/day (burstable), with auto-throttle to your baseline if >2x expected sustained spike
- Billing: pay-as-you-go top-up for actual usage during window at hosted list rate less 15% one-time discount
- Alternate: flat-rate add-on at $7,500 for the window (covers up to 200K tokens total during extension; overage billed at list rate)
- SLA/ops: 99.5% availability for the reserved buffer; we will provide telemetry hooks and a shared Ops Slack channel for the duration
- Cancellation/rollback: automatic throttle and fallback to the original pilot cap if we detect sustained load >2x for 6 consecutive minutes; we will notify you and provide a short incident report

Attachments: SOW-draft-conditional-extension.docx (short addendum with both billing options and signature block)
Related HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3401/1483
DocuSign (ready if you want to sign): https://www.docusign.net/en/link/abc123-vectra-extension

If that matches your needs, reply with the preferred billing option (usage-topup w/ 15% discount or flat $7,500) and Victor can confirm the safe upper bound on tokens/day. We'll route the SOW to DocuSign once you confirm.

Best,
Rishi
VP, Growth
Redwood Inference
